title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-xy4c: std_ext FragmentReceiver has 3 type errors (Vec<bool> vs u64 bitmap) preventing --features std build
description: The std_ext FragmentReceiver at rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs:1226-1282 has three mismatched-type errors where `window_bitmap()` returns `Vec<bool>` but `Ack::new()` expects `u64`. Lines 1237, 1254, 1281 all pass `&bitmap` (`&Vec<bool>`) where a `u64` bitmap is required. Additionally, line 1057 (`pub use std_ext::*`) triggers an unused-import warning. This prevents building lichen-schc with `--features std`. The no_std FragmentReceiver at line 722 uses `[u64; 2]` bitmaps and works correctly — the std_ext variant needs to either convert the Vec<bool> to u64 or use the same packed bitmap approach.
